audit_findings.finding: Existing JSON page numbering/topics are not aligned to the original PDF. Example: JSON pages 1-5 discuss human error, safety culture, near-miss, pointing/calling and ramp markings; original PDF printed pages 1-5 are preface, contents, contents, General and Aircraft Safety. Existing JSON must not be treated as source-verified.
audit_findings.image_mapping: Existing JSON references 001.jpg onward; image folder files use unpadded names such as 0.jpg, 1.jpg and include numbering gaps. No exact filename matches were found. Numeric normalization alone is not sufficient to establish semantic image-to-page mapping.
